summary: Phase 6 (Reports + Finance) end-to-end tested. All 11 Phase-6 backend endpoints pass with correct shapes; all return 403 for non-admin (technician); openapi.json includes all 11 new paths; regression endpoints (/reports/business-summary and /finances/income-by-category) still work. Frontend: ReportsHub renders with 11 tiles + KPI strip; DateRangePicker with all 6 presets updates ?start&end&preset; all 12 pages (business-summary, forecast, revenue-by-city/crew/customer, gross-sales, invoiced-items, income-by-category, income-categories, payments, auto-billing, impexp) render without console errors; Forecast 30d/60d/90d toggles work; slice-export CSV button, recharts charts and tables render; payments-export and payments table present; auto-billing shows 3 toggles + Run all due opens run-confirm-modal and confirming succeeds; impexp upload-input/run-import/run-export all present (run-export appears after Export tab click); income-categories CRUD add+delete works using new-cat-input/new-cat-add and cat-del-{name} (window.confirm accepted); sidebar nav-group-toggle-reports/finance both toggle. Regression on customer portal (/portal/home) works.

ui_bugs.component: Route guard on /reports, /payments, /auto-billing, /impexp, /income-categories, /income-by-category and all /reports/* sub-pages
ui_bugs.issue: Technician user (mike@aquaterra.com) can navigate directly to /reports and every Phase-6 admin page — the full ReportsHub UI renders (all 11 tiles + KPI strip) with $0.00 values because API calls 403 and the pages fall back to empty state instead of redirecting. Sidebar correctly hides the groups, but there is no client-side admin-only <Route guard>. The spec says 'technician mike@aquaterra.com cannot access /reports (should redirect or 403)'. Same issue for /payments (renders with 0 records), etc.

action_items: Add a client-side admin guard (e.g., <RequireRole role='admin'>) around Phase-6 routes in /app/frontend/src/App.js so non-admin users are redirected to /dashboard (or /jobs for techs) instead of seeing the ReportsHub shell with $0.00 fallbacks.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend routes for Phase-6 pages are not wrapped with an admin-role check — hiding nav is not enough; users can deep-link to /reports and see the shell rendered.

Backend properly enforces require_admin on all 11 endpoints (403 verified), so the risk is UI-level information exposure only, but pages showing $0.00 values without an 'access denied' message is confusing UX.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all 12 pages + all data-testids + flows work; 1 access-control regression)

seed_data_creation: TEST_CAT_X income category was added and then deleted during CRUD test — no leftover.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Phase-6 fully green. Only outstanding issue is a client-side admin guard on Phase-6 routes so techs cannot see the pages by deep-linking. After main agent adds the guard, re-verify by logging in as mike@aquaterra.com and visiting /reports, /payments, /auto-billing, /impexp, /income-categories, /income-by-category — each should redirect or show a 403/forbidden view.
rca of the issue: AppLayout hides the Reports/Finance nav groups for non-admin users, but the corresponding <Route path='/reports' element={<ReportsHub/>}/> entries in /app/frontend/src/App.js do not check user role, so any authenticated user can navigate directly. Fix: wrap those routes with an admin-role check component, e.g. element={user.role==='admin' ? <ReportsHub/> : <Navigate to='/dashboard'/>}
